caption: grave digger's arena law - crush cars, freestyle the dome, race the stadium circuit.
about: Monster jam (2007) brings the stadium tour to pc: licensed monster trucks - grave digger, maximum destruction, son-uva digger - across racing, freestyle and destruction events. The car-crushing physics and the freestyle scoring loop carry the license honestly, and the arena layout keeps every run short and loud.
The windows build is off sale, carried by archive routes.
